answer: Random mutual audit blocks bulk fakes. Each applicant posts 60 credits, locked 20 epochs, to join the lagoon. Each epoch, 10% face three random auditors; one approving a fake loses its deposit, so collusion fails. A violet flag bars failed identities until a fresh deposit. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 credits, yet fakes earn near zero, caught before payout. Honest agents pay once, like one lotus, and keep undiluted rewards.
